UI_options_CU_RestartNote: Always quit to desktop and restart to apply changes (menu return is not enough).
UI_options_CU_Mode_desc: Off=vanilla untouched. Base=recommended grid for your resolution (19 at 1080p, 21 at 1440p, 23 at 4K). Base-2/-4/-6=base minus N.
UI_options_CU_FixedGrid_desc: Odd values only (even rounds up). Absolute grid, capped at vanilla. Back up saves first.
